name: M5.Translation.anchored_difference_gcd
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S U : Finset (ZMod N)), 0 ∈ S → 0 ∈ U → M5.Translation.differenceGcd S U = M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N (M5.Translation.natSupport S) (M5.Translation.natSupport U)
queries: ZMod val add sub modulo injective
guidance:
Characterize divisors of both gcds. With zero present, each original residue occurs as x-0. Conversely a divisor of N and all canonical entries divides the canonical representative of every difference; use ZMod val subtraction modulo N. Do not claim raw support gcd invariance before anchoring. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
Exact imported local API (Lean Explore only searches external libraries):
M5.Connectivity.support_gcd_dvd : ∀ (N d : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), d ∣ M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N A B ↔ d ∣ N ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, d ∣ a) ∧ (∀ b ∈ B, d ∣ b)
